We present a novel approach to feature extraction for a CNN that has been trained to diagnose and classify Diabetic Retinography.

1) We present a method for identifying learned features of a Convolutional neural network (CNN) and 2) We apply this method to the diagnosis of Diabetic retinopathy in retinal fundus images using DenseNet.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the visualisation and understanding of CNNs.
developing a method for identifying learned features from CNNs and applying it to the task of DR diagnosis.
the development of a method for feature extraction from CNNs which is demonstrated in the context of DR classification.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we are able to demonstrate that CNNs can be used to classify images of Diabetic Retiopathy and that they are able to identify features in these images that contribute to the classification.
we have developed an effective method for visualising the learned features of CNNs and have successfully applied this to the diagnosis of DR.
the method described here has been demonstrated to work and is a useful tool for understanding CNNs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated the ability to visualise the features of a CNN, in this case for DR, which is a complex medical image classification problem.
we have successfully demonstrated that CNN feature maps can be used to visualise the features which have led to a classification.
this paper demonstrates that the DenseNet is able to identify features of DR in fundal images which are not visible to the naked eye.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the feature extraction process is a useful tool in the development of CNNs, and that the feature maps can be used as a tool to understand and explain CNN predictions.
the feature extraction method can be used to determine the features of a CNN which have led to a classification.

CNNs can be trusted to identify the features of the images that lead most strongly to a classification, and these features can be visualised to help users and clinicians to understand and trust CNN predictions.
